Results.ReviewText: I had the spirit e210 for many years. The 210 has drop down tables on the sides. When I decided to upgrade to the 310, I could not find any with drop down sides. After contacting Weber I was assured the e310 also has drop down sides even though I could not find one in stores. Well guess what. The e310 does not come with drop down sides. I’ve tried to purchase the shelves from Weber and they will not sell them to me. I now own a Weber e310 with no side shelfs because I do not have the room with the stationary shelves installed. It will be the last Weber I’ll own strictly based on their inability to know their own products.
Results.Title: Not as good as the e210

Results.ReviewText: We bought a spirit e310 about 8-10 years ago for around $100 less than today’s price.  The grill heats hotter in the rear burner, about the same in the front two. Warmer sits above the rear burner so you can adjust the rear heat and grill up front. I wasn’t going to write a review but I just bought replacement flavor bars ( for the third time) and thought I’d tell everyone how happy we are with it. We replaced the starter8 twice, the burner once and the grill grates once. We are in Upstate NewYork and grill well into winter. A grill cover is mandatory.  It’s not too heavy so we can easily wheel it from porch to garage in deep winter. Propane tank is very easy to swap when empty. Great value for the price.
Results.Title: Durable, flavorful, easy repairs

Results.ReviewText:

Results.ReviewText: Very high quality grill, and it was easy to assemble. The only issue I've had thus far is some pretty large flare-ups when cooking burgers. I'm going to give them another shot, but they didn't do well the first time I tried them. So far I've cooked ribs, wings, chicken, hot dogs, brats, and kebabs, all with great results. Indirect heating works great for slower cooks, and you get a great grilled flavor from the flavorizer bars. The grill comes to heat very quickly and delivers consistent heat throughout. The very front of the grates tends to run a little cold, but everything from the front 1/3 to all the way to the back heats and cooks evenly.
Results.Title: Very High Quality Grill

Results.ReviewText: As with all my Weber products, the quality is second to none. Great design!!  No flare ups, even heating and easy clean up.
Results.Title: Awesome Product

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
